# FicWrapped

> FicWrapped is a free, fan-made AO3 Wrapped: it reads a reader's Archive of Our Own (AO3) History in their own browser and turns it into shareable year-in-review cards (top fandoms, ships, characters, tags, most-reread fic, reading by month, reader type). It never asks for the AO3 password and uploads nothing. A bookmarklet works on desktop and mobile browsers; a paste mode works anywhere. Saving the loaded History as a CSV or an offline page is free. An optional $3.99 Supporter Pack adds a printable poster and cards without the web address. AO3 has no official Wrapped. Not affiliated with the OTW or AO3.

## Definition
AO3 Wrapped is a fan-made, Spotify-Wrapped-style year in review of your reading on Archive of Our Own (AO3). AO3 has no official one. FicWrapped builds it from your AO3 History, inside your own browser.

## Key facts (checked 25 November 2026)
- Official AO3 Wrapped: None. As of 25 November 2026, AO3 has no official Wrapped or personal year-in-review feature.
- Where the data comes from: Your AO3 History, at archiveofourown.org/users/your-name/readings. It shows 25 works per page, most recently visited first, and only you can open it, while logged in.
- Which fics count for 2026: A fic counts for 2026 if you last opened it in 2026. AO3 stores only the most recent visit date for each work, so a fic read in March and reopened in October counts in October.
- Fics: Each work counts once, however many times you opened it. Works you opened but didn't finish still count: AO3 records visits, not finished reads.
- Words: The work's full word count as shown on AO3, not the chapters you actually read.
- Visits: AO3's own "Visited N times" counter for each work, which is how the most-reread card is chosen.
- Deleted works: Counted separately. AO3 keeps only the date for them, so they aren't in the fandom or tag totals.
- AO3 outage, 2026: AO3 was offline from 29 October to 15 November 2026, so no one's History has visits from those days.
- Reading time: Total words ÷ 250 words a minute.
- Speed: The bookmark reads about one History page (25 fics) a second. If AO3 asks it to slow down, it waits and carries on.
- What you need: An AO3 account, logged in, with History switched on (AO3 Preferences → Turn on History).
- FicWrapped: A free, open-source fan tool first published on 25 November 2026. It never asks for your AO3 password and uploads nothing.

## Ways to make an AO3 Wrapped, compared (checked 25 November 2026)
- Website that logs in for you: password or cookie needed: Yes, your AO3 password; runs: Their server; phone: Yes; owner can see: Everything your account can see, until you change your password
- Colab notebook or script: password or cookie needed: Your AO3 username and password, or cookie values copied from a logged-in AO3 page; runs: Google's servers; phone: Awkward; owner can see: Depends on the code; the notebook runs with your login
- Browser extension: password or cookie needed: No; runs: Your browser; phone: Only where the browser supports extensions (e.g. Firefox for Android); owner can see: Whatever its permissions allow
- Bookmarklet (FicWrapped): password or cookie needed: No; runs: Your own AO3 tab; phone: Yes, Safari and Chrome; owner can see: Nothing: the list goes from your AO3 tab to the FicWrapped tab
- Paste History pages (FicWrapped): password or cookie needed: No; runs: The FicWrapped page; phone: Yes; owner can see: Only what you paste

## AO3 Wrapped tools, named (checked 26 November 2026, from each tool's own page; not tested or audited)
- BotHermione Wrapped (https://www.bothermione.com/wrapped): Asks for your AO3 password and logs in for you; says it stores none of your details. Runs: Their server (the page says a Flask container on Heroku). Phone: Not stated. Price: Not stated. Source: Its own page; the text refers to 2023.
- ao3wrapped (teresachenec) (https://github.com/teresachenec/ao3wrapped): You type your AO3 username and password into the Python script. Runs: Your own computer (Python). Phone: Not stated. Price: Free (public code). Source: GitHub README.
- ao3-wrapped (twitchy-ears) (https://github.com/twitchy-ears/ao3-wrapped): Asks for your AO3 username and password, then scans History. Runs: Your own computer (Python script, Windows or Linux app). Phone: Not stated. Price: Free (public code, GPL-3.0). Source: GitHub README.
- Colab notebook (nyxbda) (https://any-other-fandom-blog.tumblr.com/post/738316878158692352/for-those-who-are-not-as-familiar-with-python-and): AO3 username and password by default; the author also describes an extension route. Runs: Google Colab, or your own computer. Phone: Not stated. Price: Not stated. Source: Author's Tumblr post.
- AO3 Wrapped 2025 Colab (lynx-laurel) (https://www.reddit.com/r/AO3/comments/1pd48sl/ao3_wrapped_2025/): You paste cookie values copied from your logged-in AO3 page, so it reads History as you. Runs: Google Colab. Phone: Not stated. Price: Not stated. Source: Author's Reddit post (December 2025).
- AO3-Wrapped notebook (anulomufa) (https://github.com/anulomufa/AO3-Wrapped): You run a Login cell to sign in to AO3; the method isn't described. Runs: Google Colab or Jupyter. Phone: Not stated. Price: Free (public code). Source: GitHub README.
- AO3 Wrapped (ao3wrapped.vercel.app) (https://ao3wrapped.vercel.app/): Chrome extension; the site says no AO3 username or password is needed. Runs: Your browser, according to the site. Phone: Not stated. Price: Not stated. Source: Its own home page (no install link found).
- AO3-wrapped Firefox add-on (Ariadne) (https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/ao3-wrapped/): Firefox extension with access to archiveofourown.org; marked beta. Runs: Your browser. Phone: Listed for Firefox for Android. Price: Not stated. Source: Mozilla add-ons listing.
- AO3+ Firefox add-on (Gita) (https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/ao3-plus/): Firefox extension; includes a yearly stats page called AO3 Wrapped. Runs: Your browser. Phone: Listed for Firefox for Android. Price: Not stated. Source: Mozilla add-ons listing.
- FicWrapped (this site) (https://ficwrapped.yansquared.com/): Bookmark on your logged-in AO3 tab, or paste History pages; never asks for a password. Runs: Your own browser. Phone: Yes: Safari or Chrome bookmark, or paste. Price: Free; optional $3.99 Supporter Pack. Source: This site.
FicWrapped is the maker's own tool.

## Questions and answers
### Is there an official AO3 Wrapped?
No. AO3 doesn't make a personal year-in-review. Every AO3 Wrapped is fan-made from your AO3 History. FicWrapped is one of them: it reads your History in your own browser and turns it into shareable cards, without asking for your password.

### How do I do AO3 Wrapped?
Drag the AO3 Wrapped bookmark from ficwrapped.yansquared.com to your bookmarks bar, open AO3 while logged in and click it. It reads your History pages for the year, then you click Open my Wrapped to see and save your cards. It takes about a minute for most readers.

### How do I see my AO3 reading stats?
AO3 doesn't show reading statistics. Its Statistics page (My Dashboard → Statistics) only covers your own works and account: hits, kudos, comment threads, bookmarks, subscriptions and word count. AO3 says that for privacy reasons, further statistics about a user's activity aren't available. If History is turned on, AO3 does track when and how often you visited each work. FicWrapped reads that History in your own browser and turns it into reading stats for the year: fics and words opened, top fandoms, ships, characters and tags.

### Does FicWrapped need my AO3 password?
No. You log in to AO3 yourself, on AO3, as usual. The bookmark runs in that AO3 tab, reads only your History pages and passes the list to the FicWrapped tab you open. It never sees your password or cookies, and nothing is uploaded to a server.

### What AO3 Wrapped tools are there?
None are official; all are fan-made. On 26 November 2026 we found a website that logs in for you (BotHermione Wrapped), Python scripts you run yourself (teresachenec's ao3wrapped and twitchy-ears' ao3-wrapped), Colab notebooks (lynx-laurel's AO3 Wrapped 2025, nyxbda's and anulomufa's), browser extensions (ao3wrapped.vercel.app for Chrome, and the AO3-wrapped and AO3+ add-ons for Firefox) and FicWrapped, which uses a bookmark or pasted History pages. The table on our AO3 Wrapped without a password page lists what each one says about passwords, where it runs and phones.

### Which AO3 Wrapped tools ask for my AO3 password?
Going by their own pages on 26 November 2026: BotHermione Wrapped, teresachenec's ao3wrapped, twitchy-ears' ao3-wrapped and the default mode of nyxbda's Colab notebook ask for your AO3 username and password, and lynx-laurel's AO3 Wrapped 2025 notebook asks for cookie values from your logged-in AO3 page, which lets it read your account as you. The ao3wrapped.vercel.app Chrome extension says it needs neither, and FicWrapped never asks for a password. The two Firefox add-on listings don't say either way, and anulomufa's notebook has a login step whose method isn't described. We haven't tested or audited these tools.

### Is there an AO3 Wrapped that doesn't need my password?
Yes. Tools that run in your own logged-in browser, like bookmarklets and some extensions, or that read History pages you paste, never receive your AO3 password. FicWrapped works both ways. Websites, scripts and most Colab notebooks that log in for you do need it.

### Can I make my AO3 Wrapped on my phone?
Yes. On iPhone Safari and Android Chrome you can save the bookmark code as a bookmark and tap it on AO3; the steps are on the home page. If that's fiddly, copy your History pages one at a time and paste them into FicWrapped instead.

### Why does my Wrapped count fics I didn't finish?
AO3 History records every work you open, not every work you finish, and it shows each work's full word count. So the totals are fics and words you opened. Most AO3 Wrapped tools count the same way.

### Why do some months look empty?
AO3 keeps only the last time you visited each work. If you read a fic in February and reopened it in November, it shows up in November. Fics you removed from your History, or read while logged out or with History off, aren't counted. AO3 was also offline from 29 October to 15 November 2026, so no one's History has visits from those days.

### Why is my AO3 History empty?
AO3 only saves History while it's switched on. Check Preferences on AO3 and turn on History. If you cleared your History, those visits are gone and no tool can get them back.

### Why are my numbers lower than I expected?
Usually because AO3 keeps only the last date you opened each work: a fic you read in 2025 and reopened in 2026 counts once, in 2026, and rereads count as one fic. Fics read while logged out, with History switched off, or removed from History aren't counted. And AO3 was offline from 29 October to 15 November 2026, so those weeks are empty for everyone.

### How long does it take?
About one second per History page of 25 fics, so 400 fics take around 20 seconds. If AO3 asks it to slow down, FicWrapped waits and continues on its own. You can also stop early and use what's loaded.

### Is FicWrapped free?
Yes, the whole Wrapped is free. An optional $3.99 Supporter Pack adds a printable poster and cards without the web address. Saving your History as a CSV or an offline page is free.

### Who is FicWrapped for, and when should I use something else?
FicWrapped is for AO3 readers who want a year in review of their own reading without giving a website their password. It works in any browser that can run a bookmark, including phones, or by pasting your History. Use something else if you want statistics for all of AO3 (AO3's yearly statistics posts cover the whole archive) or numbers for works you posted (your AO3 dashboard has Stats for those). If your AO3 History was switched off, FicWrapped can only count what History recorded.

### Is it safe to run a bookmark on AO3?
A bookmark runs code in the AO3 tab, so only use ones you can read. FicWrapped's script is short, published at ficwrapped.yansquared.com/c.js and on GitHub, and it only fetches your own History and Marked for Later list pages, about one a second. It never opens a work, so it can't add works to your History or add hits. FicWrapped is an unofficial fan tool. If you'd rather not run any code on AO3, use the paste option.

### Will AO3 block me for using it?
FicWrapped reads your History at about the pace of someone clicking Next, and it backs off when AO3 says to retry later. That's far gentler than downloading fics. If AO3 is down or under maintenance, wait and try again later.

### Can I make an AO3 Wrapped for last year?
Partly. Choose 2025 in the Year menu. Because AO3 keeps only the last date you visited each work, fics you reopened in 2026 have moved to 2026, so a 2025 Wrapped made now is incomplete.

### Does FicWrapped show the AO3 top ships of 2026?
No. The AO3 top ships lists you see each year are site-wide rankings compiled by fans from AO3's public statistics. FicWrapped shows your own top ships: the relationships tagged on the fics you opened.

### Can I also download the fics in my Wrapped?
FicWrapped links each fic in the History export to its AO3 page. To turn AO3's HTML downloads into an EPUB for Kindle, Kobo or Apple Books, use FicToEpub, a free converter by the same maker.

### Can other people see my AO3 History?
No. AO3 only lets the account owner open their History, and only while logged in. It lists each work you opened, the last date you visited it and how many times. You can delete single entries, clear it, or switch it off in Preferences.

### Where is my AO3 History?
Log in, click your name in the top menu and choose History, or go to archiveofourown.org/users/your-name/readings. Marked for Later is a tab on the same page.

### If I switch History off, is my old History deleted?
No. AO3 says works you visited while History was on are still saved after you switch it off; you just have to switch it back on to see them. To remove them, use Clear History, which can't be undone.

## What FicWrapped is not
- Not an official AO3 or OTW product, and not affiliated with them.
- Never asks for the AO3 password or session cookie.
- Uploads nothing: History is read in the user's browser and passed between tabs with postMessage.
- Does not show site-wide AO3 statistics such as the yearly top ships lists; it shows the user's own reading.
